newline: lf, bom: no
preamble:
  shebang: #!/usr/bin/env dotnet
  directive: package Reverb.Runtime 0.1.0
  header: v1
cells:
  [0] setup
      | using Reverb;
  [1] code id=factor
      | var factor = 3;
  [2] code id=helpers
      | static int Square(int x) => x * x;
      | int Scale(int x) => x * factor;
  [3] code id=use
      | var squared = Square(4);
      | var scaled = Scale(5);
      | Func<int, int> squareIt = Square;
      | Console.WriteLine($"{squared} {scaled} {squareIt(6)}");
diagnostics: none
